focus_areas: Refraction and reflection consistency on faceted turquoise beads
Physical plausibility of bead threading and connections
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the physics of the bead arrangement. In AI-generated images, complex beaded structures often suffer from 'fusion' where beads merge into each other without visible stringing material. Check if the reflections on the faceted beads are consistent with a single light source. Verify if the clasp connects logically to the rest of the strand.

A silver-toned clasp mechanism is visible at the top right.
